coverage.functional_specification: Sections 6.7 and 6.8 describe CPU-programmed decoding/encoding. No conclusion about a mandatory codec firmware follows from the upstream VPU/SCP driver.
coverage.decoder_register_table: Section 4.7, pages 799-820, documents VDEC_GCON, not the frame-programming banks.
coverage.encoder_register_table: Section 4.8, pages 821-822, documents three clock/chip-enable registers, not frame programming.
coverage.existing_kernel: Accepted kernel has no MT6797 mtk-vcodec match and omits the VDECSYS provider. Isolated e87e65549920 candidate enables the existing open-source provider, larb1 and a direct decoder DT node. No hardware video driver is installed as the accepted default; existing video nodes are JPEG only.
coverage.related_silicon: Pinned public GPL MT8173 and MT6795 hardware verification interfaces supply candidate H.264 register and initialization facts. Hardware compatibility is tested individually; no completed frame is yet qualified.

fifo_probe.status: Four successful input DMA/barrel comparisons after nineteen timeouts in input-only trials; guarded frame testing is recorded separately in frame_probe

attempts.reason: Initial read-only SSH health guard timed out before upload or module load

attempts.experimental_difference: Separate common-SRAM reset at VLD 0x2ec bit8; second variant also enables older asynchronous write pointer at VLD 0xd0 bit18 after barrel reset. Both time out; both stop/guard checks pass.
attempts.boot_trial_failure: RTC alarm delivery-before interrupt-count check, irq_delta=0; candidate not qualified; supervised recovery and final source/no-writer audit passed

attempts.experimental_difference: Cleared MISC 0xf4 bit0 before input initialization, following the public related-core common caller; all four mask combinations fetched and compared both known barrel words exactly.
attempts.boot_trial_failure: RTC alarm delivery-after interrupt-count check; supervised recovery and final source/no-writer audits passed

fifo_probe.note: Boot qualification is separate from input/frame proof. Trials 01-04 retained mappings until reboot. Trial 05, both trial-07 matrices and trials 08/09 acknowledged documented break/idle and unloaded normally. Trial 06 did not load a module because its initial SSH health guard timed out. Trial 09 failed its first RTC alarm delivery check but passed supervised recovery and source/no-writer audits. No frame DMA was started. Trial 12 clears MISC 0xf4 bit0 and compares known input words in all four local/legacy mask combinations; all stops and buffer guards pass. Its boot qualification failed the final RTC alarm interrupt-count check; supervised recovery and final source/no-writer audits passed.
fifo_probe.current_stop_contract: MT6797 documented MISC break command, both acknowledgement bits, then idle reset; uncertain stop pins mappings, power and module until reboot
fifo_probe.current_global_clock_control: Documented VDEC_GCON 0x18 bit 0 disables global automatic clock-off; programmed through existing syscon regmap, clock and reset registers left to frameworks
fifo_probe.observed_stop: Trial 05: both break acknowledgement bits 0x11 and idle reset passed; mappings, clocks and power released and the module unloaded normally despite failed input comparison.
fifo_probe.current_write_ordering: Each APB write completes with arm64 mb() / DSB SY, matching the public sync_write primitive; per-attempt sources distinguish versions.
fifo_probe.endpoint_note: Early DMA30 allocation could place the exclusive FIFO end at 1 GiB. Current code allocates a trailing guard and rejects an endpoint beyond the DMA mask; the padded trial-07 matrix still timed out with both endpoint words fitting 24 bits.
fifo_probe.current_mapping: Codec banks use resource-managed non-posted Device-nGnRnE by default, matching the public MT6797 driver userspace mapping; trial 08 still timed out

supplier_snapshot.interpretation: VDEC power acknowledgements set; reset released, isolation/clock-disable/SRAM-PDN bit8 and SRAM-ACK bit12 clear. PLL control 0x121, PCW 0xd0000, power 0x80000001 and mux 0x81010100 observed. Configured 338 MHz, not independently measured. Bits9-11 remain set; the matching public MT6797 power implementation uses only SRAM bit8, so the snapshot does not justify additional power writes.

clock_meter.guard_refusal: Existing CKGEN divider setting 1; first two diagnostics refused before register writes. Captured state is not a frequency measurement. Revised diagnostic reports counter-input rate after the unchanged divider.
clock_meter.note: Nonzero AXI/VDEC/MM counts establish signal presence at the meter. Counter-input rates are after unchanged divider field 1; no upstream divider encoding, hardware input transfer or frame output is inferred.

frame_probe.note: Twenty-five frame commands through trial 19 have no completed-frame comparison. Clearing newer MISC 0x178 to zero enables partial pixel output; its reference mask 0x1f does not. All four zero-mask jobs change 4,992 output bytes and yield 64 MV flags, with MC coordinates 3/3. PCM output matches 4,608 of 6,144 MM21 samples, with 384 written chroma mismatches; grey matches all 4,992 written samples, leaving 1,152 poisoned samples. Missing luma strips are rows 12..15, 28..31 and 44..47. The MC bank8 bit makes no output difference; MC 0x920 bit24 was already set. Clock readback/restoration, guards, idle/unload and full system/RTC/recovery pass. Full output layout and frame completion remain unqualified. Next test supplies newer TOP pixel dimensions and separately checks PP routes and the MISC CRC/access bit.
